question: The amphibians of plant kingdom are ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bryophytes.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Bryophytes:

 
 
• In the plant kingdom, bryophytes are known as amphibians.
 
• A bryophyte is a nonvascular plant that is green, seedless and belongs to the mosses, liverworts, or hornworts family.
 
• Bryophytes are among the simplest of terrestrial plants.</li&
